skill_tests.title: Heaps and Priority Queues Skill Test
skill_tests.description: Test your knowledge of binary heaps, priority queues, and related LeetCode-style problems.
skill_tests.instructions: This test contains 2 multiple-choice questions and 2 coding problems on Heaps. You have 45 minutes to complete. Read each question carefully.

skill_tests.title: Trees and Binary Search Trees Skill Test
skill_tests.description: Assess your understanding of binary trees, BSTs, and tree traversal algorithms.
skill_tests.instructions: This test contains 1 single-choice question, 1 multiple-choice question, and 2 coding problems on Trees. You have 60 minutes to complete.

skill_tests.title: Graphs and Graph Algorithms Skill Test
skill_tests.description: Evaluate your knowledge of graph representation, BFS, DFS, and island-type problems.
skill_tests.instructions: This test contains 2 multiple-choice questions and 1 coding problem on Graphs. You have 45 minutes to complete.

skill_tests.title: Dynamic Programming Skill Test
skill_tests.description: Test your mastery of memoization, tabulation, and classic DP problems like Climbing Stairs and LCS.
skill_tests.instructions: This test contains 1 multiple-choice question and 2 coding problems on Dynamic Programming. You have 60 minutes to complete.
